visualCharacteristics.purpose: teaser of a few current, time-limited membership offers
visualCharacteristics.description: 3 offer cards in a row with thin grey vertical dividers between them: product image centered on top, then a large red amount with superscript $ and smaller OFF, the uppercase product name (condensed font), and "Valid until M/D/YYYY"; 3 per row on desktop, 2 on tablet, 1 on mobile (dividers become horizontal when stacked).

contentPattern.structure: one row per offer; cell 1 = offer image (alt = product name); cell 2 = three paragraphs: the amount ("<sup>$</sup>3.00 OFF"), the product title, and "Valid until M/D/YYYY"
contentPattern.notes: Text lines are recognized by pattern, so their order doesn't matter: the line ending in OFF is the amount, the line starting with "Valid until" is the validity, the remaining line is the title. The trailing OFF is wrapped in a span and sized smaller. An empty image alt falls back to the title. The heading, intro and Sign Up button above stay default content.

suitableFor: coupon-style cards: product image, discount amount, product name, expiry
